findings.title: Stars are completely fogged out — invisible at night
findings.detail: Stars are placed at distance 150-200 from the player (starDist=150+hashF(...)*50) but rendered through the mob shader (progM) with fog parameters uFogNearM=26, uFogFarM=80. At distance 150, the fog factor computes to clamp((150-26)/(80-26), 0, 1) = 1.0, so all 80 stars are fully blended into the fog color (which matches the night sky color), making them invisible. The twinkle logic is correct but stars can never be seen.
